The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the case of unweighted trees, the distortion is not a function of the number of nodes of the tree, but rather a function of the depth of the tree.
for the line embedding case, the problem of minimizing the additive distortion is easier than the multiplicative one, and that the additive problem is easier than the distortion-free one.
, surprisingly, for the problem of low-distortion embeddings of graphs into a line, the standard notion of multiplicative distortion is not the appropriate measure of distortion.
